build_vit_model: build a Vision Transformer model using the Model factory function with variant and num_classes arguments
create_encoder_block: create a transformer encoder block with configurable num_heads, mlp_dim, and dropout settings
load_pretrained_checkpoint: load pretrained ViT checkpoint from GCS URL with automatic posemb resampling and old checkpoint fixing
decode_variant_config: decode a variant string like B/16 into model configuration dict with width, depth, mlp_dim, and num_heads
resample_position_embeddings: resample position embeddings from old grid size to new grid size for high-resolution finetuning
